mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reservoir and beds was most worthwhile: it brought the separate parts together and explained how one system can serve different root zones.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lining the beds was practical but less engaging than the irrigation steps; it mostly continued the straightforward assembly.

surprise.text: The return hose aerates the solution by letting it fall into the reservoir, a useful detail I had not anticipated.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; even the drain runs had an understandable purpose in keeping water from collecting around roots.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see the empty beds put to use, especially after the chapter explained how their different root zones are supported.
